trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt. The whole list is offline, there are no difficulty settings, and one playthrough is enough; guides put the full run at roughly 200 hours. Keep cheats off for the entire run, because cheats disable both trophies and saving.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap — https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It pops by itself as the mission wraps up and cannot be missed, so just play the introduction and it is yours.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for seeing Chapter 1 through to the end. In practice it unlocks once you complete the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, and like every chapter trophy it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 completion trophy. It unlocks after you finish the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, and cannot be missed on a normal story run.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 completion trophy. It unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, are done. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 completion trophy. It unlocks after Chapter 4's final main mission, Starting From Zero. Automatic and unmissable as long as you finish the chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the final story mission. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save before the endgame if you want a way back; once the credits roll you return to free-roam and everything else on the list stays available.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the mission itself and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play, a Chapter 4 main mission. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission set around the airport. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 main mission. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The long gold. The 100% Completion checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but everything you do during the story already counts toward it. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — closer to 60% of everything in the game: most side quests and collectible types are not needed at all, and of the ones that are, you typically need 70–80%. Habits that pay off early: scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app (any 200 of 277 base models count) and study animals through the binoculars (any 100 of 255), and clear 100 optional missions as they appear. Only five categories must be done in full: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests, plus 70 of the 80 challenges. Nothing toward it is missable; it can all be finished in free-roam after the credits.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap — https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts out of the 397 scattered across Leonida. They come in four flavours — 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — and you can mix freely, so lean on the under-bridge flights, which guides rate the quickest. Track progress per region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and note the 100% checklist separately asks for 300 stunts, so keep going after this pops.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. The story introduces most of them for you, and the rest appear as blue icons once you unfog the map; check what you are missing under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. A normal trophy run crosses all nine off without trying.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is one of the few categories the 100% checklist wants done completely, so there is no skipping the awkward ones — learn each range's target pattern, retry freely, and work through them range by range rather than leaving them all for the end.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap — https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. A win — not just a finish — is needed at every course, and drone races are another category the 100% checklist requires in full, so replay a course until the win is banked before moving on.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add up, so keep moving to fresh events on the map and tick them off as you travel. Races also count as one of the activity types for Master of None.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list — https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal's fishing challenge and out-catch him. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so this doubles as progress for Master of None; learn the reeling rhythm on ordinary fishing first so the challenge itself is one-and-done.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to completion at any arcade cabinet you find. A video game also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None, so this is two birds with one token.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list — https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's whole questline by completing his final mission (listed elsewhere as Puff Puff Pass). Andy's missions are played as Lucia, and like every trophy quest giver he is available again in free-roam after the story, so a strand left unfinished is never lost — pick it back up during cleanup.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list — https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline by completing his final mission. Kenton can become temporarily unavailable at points during the story — that is normal, not a lockout: every trophy quest giver returns later, and he is still there in free-roam after the credits.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline by completing his final mission. Work the strand whenever Billy's icon is up, or leave it for the post-story cleanup — the questline stays available in free-roam.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list — https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers anywhere in Leonida. Strangers & Freaks are not part of the 100% checklist, so this is its own cleanup job: the named questlines for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are the backbone, open-world strangers are still around after the story, and finishing any eight strands pops it.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline by completing his final mission. Randy's vehicle deliveries along the way each count as optional missions toward the 100% checklist, so his strand pays double — do the deliveries as they appear rather than saving them all for the end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline by completing his final mission. Tyrone's missions are played as Jason, and the strand remains available in free-roam after the story if you leave it late.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the one trophy on this list that can be lost. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, but the danger is the very first one: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That balcony meditation adds +1 to the counter in the Progress menu but is not marked as a meditation spot like the others, so guides cannot confirm whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx's author did it and earned the trophy, so do it; once Chapter 1 ends the moment is gone for good. The remaining spots can be done in free-roam (the last ones need both characters playable, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2), and meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts double toward optional-mission progress.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap — https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting questline to the hunt for its unique animal and bring it down. Bret's quests are played as Jason and are one of the five categories the 100% checklist requires in full, so finish the whole strand rather than stopping at this trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game and the 100% checklist eventually wants 15 of them completed, so treat this trophy as the warm-up: pick the three sets you are closest to finishing, complete those first, and keep collecting — the rest of the sets are already spoken for by A Long Road.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap — https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 marked locations around Leonida. The app unlocks automatically in Chapter 1 and is the same tool you scan vehicles with, so build the habit early: whenever you stop somewhere new, WAiNK it, and the 100 will accumulate long before the post-game cleanup.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges, which come in eight groups of ten. Since the 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80 anyway, this pops on the way there — pick off the easiest challenges in each group first and leave the hardest ten alone entirely.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise the heat to a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drain away and you have fully escaped. Do it somewhere with an easy hiding route — tunnels and back streets are your friend — and make sure your partner is with you for both the raise and the escape.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list — https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in one unbroken run: the wanted level you earn at the first shop must never fully clear before the third is done. Pick a tight cluster of shops, keep moving between them so the heat stays alive without snowballing, and only shake the cops once the third till is empty.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — hold up on the D-pad, then R1 — which unlocks automatically in Chapter 1. Scan everything new you walk past, including boats and aircraft: the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so this trophy is only the halfway mark of a habit worth starting immediately.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies inside one single Combat Focus activation. Set it up rather than hoping for it: start a fight against a grouped-up gang or a robbery gone loud, let enemies cluster, then trigger Focus with a full, fast-firing weapon and sweep across the group before it ends.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list — https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, the airport, make an unscheduled departure: get yourself airborne (or out of the airport) in a way no timetable ever approved of — commandeer an aircraft and take off. Expect a wanted level for your trouble; the trophy is about the departure, not a clean getaway.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The cryptic one: it revolves around Rhino tanks and the heat they bring. When a Rhino enters the fight, stay mobile, fight from cover with heavy weapons rather than trading shots in the open, and see the encounter through — guides document the setpiece with location shots, so check the cited guide if your run stalls here.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store cleanly: get in, take the goods and get out without being detected — no alarm raised and no wanted level. Go in quiet, watch staff and camera sightlines, and resist the urge to rush; a loud smash-and-grab voids the whole attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape with the money. Bank jobs open up through an optional mission in Chapter 4, and there are 8 vaults in total — the 100% checklist wants all 8 robbed as part of its full robberies category, so plan to finish the set even though this trophy pops at five.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap — https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Pick an armored truck, crack it open, take the cash and escape the response. Block the truck somewhere it cannot flee, deal with the guards quickly, and have your getaway route picked before the doors come off — the robbery only counts once you have escaped.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list — https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — in practice, unfog the entire map. A helicopter or plane sweep is the fastest way to mop up the grey patches late in the run, but most of the state reveals itself naturally if you drive between objectives instead of fast-travelling everywhere.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list — https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of Leonida's 9 gangs — one per gang, not nine of the same crew. Gang operations also feed the robberies category of the 100% checklist (which counts 39 gang operations in total), so mark each gang off as you expand across the map.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap — https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one: head to Ocean Beach and enjoy a cocktail with a view. It is a small scripted moment rather than a challenge — find the spot on Ocean Beach, order the drink, and take in the view until it registers.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Get into a vehicle inside a showroom and leave the way the description demands: through the glass, in classic style. Take a car off the showroom floor and drive it straight out through the front windows rather than using any door.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the follow-through play the description points at — some lists describe the objective as taking the alley's key valuables, so work the location fully rather than just bowling a frame. Bowling alleys also appear among gang-operation locations, so this can coincide with robbery progress.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list — https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership trophy: lists that have pinned it down describe it as maxing out the strength stat with both Jason and Lucia. Train both characters — gym work and brawling raise strength — until each of them is at their personal best.
sources: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List — https://sixshore.com/gta-6/guides/trophies-and-achievements/

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This one tracks the choices you make as you play — PlayStation's own counter runs to 500. There is nothing special to farm: make your calls in conversations and missions, for better or worse, and the tally builds across the whole playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: the reported shape of this trophy is failing at something and then succeeding on the immediate retry. If it has not popped naturally during the story, deliberately botch a quick, repeatable attempt — a race restart is ideal — and then nail the second try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness one of Leonida's strange events — the unexplained, 'what the hell just happened?' kind. These odd encounters happen out in the world, especially away from the city and after dark; when something impossible crosses your path, stay and watch it play out instead of driving on.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, strike a pedestrian with a melee attack as you pass. Line up a lone pedestrian on a quiet street, keep your speed moderate so the swing connects, and drive through the hit rather than stopping.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies, so this builds naturally if you fence and launder after every score instead of sitting on dirty cash; keep the pipeline moving and the quarter-million arrives during the robbery grind for 100%.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list — https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicle work, everything counts. There is no reason to grind this: a 200-hour run spends far more than that, so just avoid hoarding and buy what you need.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list — https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties on the map. They unlock as your funds and story progress grow, so sweep them up during the money-rich late game; each garage bought is permanent progress, and the set completes the moment the eighth is yours.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list — https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you take a vehicle you like, register it before you ditch it; ten registrations is a small ask and you will pass it early if you make registering a habit from the start.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list — https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/
